changes.summary: Retained-power window after ignition off extended from 45 s to 60 s. The door-open cut-off is unchanged.

The trigger changed from the rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The behaviour changed from 'close quickly' to express close with anti-pinch active. This is a new interface and a new safety condition.
Pinch detection force threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N.
Minimum reversal distance increased from 125 mm to 150 mm. The 10 ms stop time is unchanged.
Rewording only ('set itself' became 'set its state'). The 500 ms threshold and the not-normalized result are unchanged.
The vague 'exceeds the limit' and 'safe value' became concrete: temperature above 130 °C and a current limit of 15 A.
WLC_Status period shortened from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content is unchanged.
Narrowed to storing DTC B1A02 only. The motor stop and the fault-state output were removed and moved to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038. The 25 A and 50 ms trigger is unchanged.

tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032. Keep the test and its WLC-004 trace, because sleep current is still worth measuring (see concerns).

tests.new_procedure: Switch ignition off. Press the switch at 50 s and at 70 s (optionally at 59 s and 61 s to check the boundary). Repeat with a front door opened at 10 s and the switch pressed afterwards. Remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window movement when the switch is pressed at 50 s after ignition off
Window movement when the switch is pressed at 70 s after ignition off
Window movement after a front door is opened (at 10 s)
new_pass_criteria.limit: No movement (until a front door is opened)

tests.reason: The retained-power time changed from 45 s to 60 s, so the old press times of 40 s and 50 s no longer test the boundary. WLC-023 is deleted and its trace must go.

tests.new_procedure: With the window half open and the controller normalized, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller (no rain signal). Repeat with an obstruction in the pinch zone to check that anti-pinch is active during the close.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Anti-pinch protection during the WLC_CloseAll close
new_pass_criteria.limit: Active (pinch detected and handled as in WLC-014 and WLC-015)

tests.reason: The trigger changed from a rain signal to WLC_CloseAll, and the requirement now needs express mode and active anti-pinch. The old test no longer matches.

tests.new_procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm. Make sure the window can travel the full reversal distance. Note that the 80 N point is now reached at a smaller rod compression than before.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Motor stop time after the pinch force exceeds 80 N
Reversal distance after the detected pinch
new_pass_criteria.limit: At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The force threshold changed to 80 N and the reversal distance to 150 mm.
The test is defined as 'As TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V', so it inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm criteria. It must be run again with them.
The test is defined as 'As TC-AP-01 at 16.0 V', so it inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm criteria. It must be run again with them.
The test inherits the new criteria from TC-AP-01. The cold, low-voltage corner is the worst case for stop time and must be re-verified (LL-2022-02).
The test inherits the new criteria from TC-AP-01 and must be run again at 85 °C.
Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018, but keep the test. LL-2021-07 requires it, and the threshold drop to 80 N makes false reversals more likely. Trace it to WLC-014 and rerun it.
WLC-021 changed in wording only, and the 500 ms threshold and result are the same.

tests.new_procedure: Run open-close cycles until the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, then command a movement and measure the motor current. Check that the thermal estimate is current (LL-2024-01).

new_pass_criteria.measure: Motor current when the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C

tests.reason: The requirement now gives a 130 °C limit and a 15 A current limit, so 'motor current reduced' is no longer an adequate criterion.

tests.new_procedure: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window. Repeat under worst-case bus load, including a diagnostic session (LL-2024-09).

new_pass_criteria.measure: Signals present: window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state

tests.reason: The cycle time changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms.

tests.new_procedure: Block the window and inject 27 A for 100 ms. Also inject a current above 25 A for less than 50 ms, as a short-pulse check, if the existing test setup allows it. Keep the motor-stop and fault-state checks only as added for WLC-037 and WLC-038.

new_pass_criteria.limit: Stored when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms

tests.reason: WLC-030 now covers only storing the DTC, so the test criteria must be re-stated. The motor stop and fault state now verify WLC-037 and WLC-038.
Its only trace is WLC-033, which is deleted. The test no longer verifies any requirement.

added.extend_test: New test needed (e.g. TC-AP-10). It can reuse the TC-AP-01 setup but needs its own timing checks. No existing test covers the 2 s inhibit.
added.pass_criteria: After a pinch reversal, an express close command issued before 2 s has elapsed is not executed (window does not close in express mode). An express close command issued after 2 s is accepted. Measure the time from the reversal.

added.extend_test: TC-DG-02 (Overcurrent). It already blocks the window and injects 27 A for 100 ms, so it can add a motor-stop check.
added.pass_criteria: When B1A02 is stored, the motor is stopped.

added.extend_test: TC-DG-02 (Overcurrent). Also record WLC_Status in the same run.
added.pass_criteria: When B1A02 is stored, the fault state in WLC_Status is set.

concerns.concern: LL-2021-07: a force threshold change needs a new check of both false reversals and stop time. Lowering the threshold to 80 N raises the false-reversal risk on rough roads. Rerun the vibration test (TC-AP-09) against 80 N and trace it to WLC-014. Do not retire it with WLC-018.
LL-2022-02: the cold (-30 °C), low-voltage (9.0 V) corner is the worst case for stop time. Run it on every software release. The 150 mm reversal makes it a harder corner than before.

These test other anti-pinch requirements (WLC-016, 017, 019) but may hard-code 100 N or 125 mm in their procedures. Review them and rerun if so. TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout) may also interact with the new 2 s express-close inhibit in WLC-039.

WLC-012 now closes by CAN request in express mode. Express close is only allowed when normalized (WLC-013, 017). The specification does not say what happens to WLC_CloseAll when the controller is not normalized, or during the WLC-039 inhibit. Ask the requirements owner and add a test.
LL-2024-01: a limit check using an estimate needs a current estimate. The thermal module is shared with WLC-200, so check that the fix is present before running the 130 °C test.
They do not trace to WLC-025, but they use the same temperature limit. Check whether WLC-024, 026 and 027 depend on the 130 °C limit, and rerun the tests that do.

LL-2024-09: when the cycle time goes from 100 ms to 50 ms, repeat the worst-case queue calculation. Test under worst bus load with a diagnostic session. WLC-012 (WLC_CloseAll) and WLC-038 (fault state) add more CAN load or signals to check.

The sleep-current requirement WLC-032 was deleted, but battery drain still matters. Keep the test and confirm that WLC-004 holds the 100 µA limit. If it does not, ask whether the deletion was intentional. Also check that the 60 s wait before measuring still fits with the longer 60 s retained-power time in WLC-007.

LL-2023-05: sensor plausibility checks need a sensor-removal test at the lowest supply voltage. WLC-029 is unchanged, but check that TC-DG-01 does this. Also WLC-030 has been split, so check that no fault-handling path (stop motor, fault state) is left untested.

Retiring it removes the only subjective check of switch feel. WLC-033 was deleted, but the team may want to keep the review as an informal evaluation. WLC-034 (company process) has no test, so nothing needs to change there.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
